# Nova API — /api/evals

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/evals`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## PUT /api/evals/\{id\}

Operation id `eval_update`: in Python `client.call("eval_update", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api eval_update`.

`PUT /api/evals/{id}` — correct a question or its known answer, `200` with the row.

Correct one eval's question and known answer in place; the runs of `GET /api/evals/{id}/runs` stay. Both fields are required and are checked exactly as `POST /api/catalog/evals` checks them. Only a member of its owner group or an administrator may correct it; the catalog and the owner group do not change.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The eval's id |

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expected` | any | Yes |  | The known answer, in the same three shapes `NewEval` takes. |  |
| `question` | string | Yes |  | The question, 1 to 500 characters. |  |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The updated row |
| `400` | The question or the expected answer is not in the accepted shape |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | Only a member of the owner group or an administrator may correct an eval |
| `404` | No such eval, or the id is not a number |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## DELETE /api/evals/\{id\}

Operation id `eval_delete`: in Python `client.call("eval_delete", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api eval_delete`.

`DELETE /api/evals/{id}` — `204`; `404` when the id is not a row.

Remove one eval. Only a member of its owner group or an administrator may delete it; the eval was stored, never executed.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The eval's id |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `204` | Deleted |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | Only a member of the owner group or an administrator may delete an eval |
| `404` | No such eval, or the id is not a number |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## GET /api/evals/\{id\}/runs

Operation id `eval_run_list`: in Python `client.call("eval_run_list", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api eval_run_list`.

`GET /api/evals/{id}/runs` — the eval's runs, newest first.

The runs of one eval — one posted answer and its verdict each — newest first. `?limit=` is 1 to 100, 20 by default. Reading a run is reading the eval's history, so the route needs a session like the rest of the API; it answers 404 for an id that is not an eval. Without a state store the route answers 503.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The eval's id |
| `limit` | query | string | No | How many runs, 1 to 100 (default 20) |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The eval's runs, newest first |
| `400` | limit is not a number from 1 to 100 |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `404` | No such eval, or the id is not a number |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |

## POST /api/evals/\{id\}/runs

Operation id `eval_run_create`: in Python `client.call("eval_run_create", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api eval_run_create`.

`POST /api/evals/{id}/runs` — compare one answer and store the verdict, `201` with the row.

Post one answer to an eval — the SQL an agent wrote, the rows it returned, or the runner's own error — and store the verdict: Nova compares it with the eval's `expected` here, never sends the rows to a model. `value` passes for one row of one equal cell (numbers by value); `rows` passes when the two tables are equal as a multiset; `uses` passes when the SQL names every expected `namespace.table`; an `error` fails with its sentence. Only a member of the eval's owner group or an administrator may post one; the caller is recorded as `createdBy`. The reason sentences are the page's text.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The eval's id |

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | string (nullable) | No |  | The model endpoint that answered, at most 200 characters. |  |
| `error` | string (nullable) | No |  | The runner's own failure (Ask refused, the statement errored), at most 2 000 characters. |  |
| `model` | string (nullable) | No |  | The model that wrote the answer, at most 200 characters. |  |
| `rows` | array of array (nullable) | No |  | The rows the statement returned: 1 to 100 rows of 1 to 50 scalars. |  |
| `sql` | string (nullable) | No |  | The statement an agent wrote, at most 20 000 characters. |  |
| `tokens` | integer (nullable) | No |  | The tokens the model call used; not negative. | format `int64` |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `201` | The stored run and its verdict |
| `400` | The answer is over one of the limits |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | Only a member of the owner group or an administrator may run an eval |
| `404` | No such eval, or the id is not a number |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |
